title: Moored Dinghies & Boats, Wooden Pier Harbor - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A scenic landscape view of a bustling harbor or bay filled with moored skiffs, dinghies, and small motorboats resting on calm waters. In the midground, a figure is visible leaning inside a rowboat, while a long wooden recreational pier with walkways and railings extends across the right side of the water. The print has distinct deckled edges characteristic of mid-20th-century amateur snapshot photography developed on Kodak Velox paper.
